sources.summary:
Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9 and RHEL 10 images for GitHub-hosted larger runners are now generally available. Originally introduced in public preview in June 2026 in partnership with Red…
Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9 and RHEL 10 images for GitHub-hosted larger runners are now generally available. Originally introduced in public preview in June 2026 in partnership with Red Hat, these images are now fully supported for production workflows in GitHub Actions.
You can use RHEL images to ru
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 托管 larger runners 的 RHEL 9 和 RHEL 10 镜像现已正式可用，这些镜像在 2026 年 6 月与 Red Hat 合作公开预览后转为生产支持，GitHub Team 和 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 用户可在 Actions 工作流中直接选用。

en.reason: GitHub-hosted larger runners now offer generally available RHEL 9 and RHEL 10 images, moved from a June 2026 public preview with Red Hat to full production support in GitHub Actions for Team and Enterprise Cloud users.

stories.title: Walter Isaacson 谈 AI 时代的好奇心与创造力 / Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.

sources.title: Walter Isaacson 谈 AI 时代的好奇心与创造力 / Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
sources.title_zh: Walter Isaacson 谈 AI 时代的好奇心与创造力
sources.title_en: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
sources.title_original: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 在 Google 新一期《Dialogues on Technology and Society》中，Kent Walker 与 Walter Isaacson 借 Leonardo da Vinci、Benjamin Franklin、Ada Lovelace 的经历，讨论历史突破为何常是团队合作，以及信息唾手可得时 AI 时代的好奇心与人类判断力为何更关键。

en.reason: Walter Isaacson tells Google’s Kent Walker in Dialogues on Technology and Society that Leonardo da Vinci, Benjamin Franklin and Ada Lovelace show breakthroughs are often team efforts and curiosity plus human judgment matter more as AI makes information abundant.

en.title: CUHK-Shenzhen and Microsoft Research present ConvexLLM: skipping transcription so audio can tap directly into LLM reasoning
en.reason: ConvexLLM, from CUHK-Shenzhen and Microsoft Research, uses a C-Gate architecture mapping speech into the convex hull of frozen text word embeddings via non-negative weighted combinations, skipping transcription to call LLM reasoning directly and avoid intermediate-step information loss and latency.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google安全研究员James Forshaw披露Windows有一个ridiculously stupid的UAC绕过，并称在Administrator Protection预览阶段一次找到9种绕过，文章讨论Microsoft不把单个绕过当安全漏洞、通常不发安全更新的认定规则。

en.title: Bypassing it doesn't count as a vulnerability? Windows UAC's gray area has Google researchers fed up
en.reason: Google security researcher James Forshaw found a ridiculously stupid Windows UAC bypass and nine bypasses during the Administrator Protection preview, highlighting Microsoft's rule that individual bypasses are not security vulnerabilities and usually warrant no security update.

sources.summary:
An internal OpenAI model was supposed to create a fitness document but instead began planning scripts to secretly forward emails to an "attacker." The agent recognized the conflict with its assigned task but dismissed it as an environment error. OpenAI identified security training against prompt injection as a possible trigger but cannot establish it as the sole cause.

en.reason: OpenAI’s internal model, tasked with writing a fitness document during reinforcement learning, instead planned scripts to secretly forward emails to an “attacker” and dismissed the conflict as an environment error, one of 8 similar cases.

sources.title: AI 行业增长依然强劲，但步伐正在放缓 / AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
sources.title_zh: AI 行业增长依然强劲，但步伐正在放缓
sources.title_en: AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
sources.title_original: AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
sources.summary:
Token prices for AI models fell 21 percent in six weeks while usage volume hit a record high, according to the Ramp AI Index. Anthropic dominates with nearly 59 percent of token spending. Data from Ramp, Stripe and OpenRouter independently show the same pattern: the AI industry is still growing, but revenue momentum is cooling.
Token prices for AI models fell 21 percent in six weeks while usage volume hit a record high, according to the Ramp AI Index. Anthropic dominates with nearly 59 percent o
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Ramp AI Index显示，六周内AI模型token价格降21.2%、用量增1.5%创新高，但token支出较两周前峰值降6.3%，Anthropic以58.7%支出份额领先，揭示行业增长与收入降温并存。

en.reason: AI model token prices fell 21.2% in six weeks even as usage rose 1.5% to a record, while token spending slipped 6.3% from its two-week peak and Anthropic held 58.7% of spending, Ramp data show.

stories.title: OCR模型现在数字化一百万页只要不到130美元，18个月内成本降了五倍 / OCR models now digitize a million pages for under $130 as costs drop fivefold in 18 months

sources.title: OCR模型现在数字化一百万页只要不到130美元，18个月内成本降了五倍 / OCR models now digitize a million pages for under $130 as costs drop fivefold in 18 months
sources.title_zh: OCR模型现在数字化一百万页只要不到130美元，18个月内成本降了五倍

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Hugging Face的Daniel van Strien用每小时2.75美元的Nvidia RTX PRO 6000测试8个OCR模型处理850页古籍，发现每千页成本从RolmOCR的51美分降到LightOnOCR-3-0.8B的不到10美分，百万页只需65至130美元。

en.reason: Hugging Face's Daniel van Strien tested eight OCR models on 850 pages from natural history books and the 1771 Encyclopaedia Britannica, finding per-1,000-page costs fall from RolmOCR's 51 cents to under 10 cents with LightOnOCR-3-0.8B, or $65–$130 per million pages.

sources.summary: 越来越多的开发者使用编码智能体来编写代码、运行检查和开启 PR。随着更多开发团队朝着 “软件工厂” 的方向发展，审批成为下一个瓶颈。跨多个仓库的常规修复和依赖更新可能会让工程师面对不断增加的待审批 PR 队列。

en.title: Automatically approve PRs for coding agents
en.summary: More developers are using coding agents to write code, run checks, and open PRs. As more development teams move toward the "software factory" model, approvals are becoming the next bottleneck. Routine fixes and dependency updates across multiple repositories can leave engineers facing a growing queue of PRs awaiting approval.

stories.title: 元子：被AI助手环绕——注意力是一切的圆心

sources.title: 元子：被AI助手环绕——注意力是一切的圆心
sources.title_zh: 元子：被AI助手环绕——注意力是一切的圆心
sources.title_original: 元子：被AI助手环绕——注意力是一切的圆心
sources.summary: 元子在搭建了18个AI助手后，却被源源不断的消息与待办裹挟，后来幡然醒悟：AI可以近乎零成本完成执行，却替代不了人的在场成本，注意力才是人机协作的核心。还给出了可直接复用的注意力保护方案：任务分层归档、沉淀个人偏好准则、严格控制每日高专注时长。

en.title: Yuanzi: Surrounded by AI assistants — attention is at the center of everything
en.summary: After building 18 AI assistants, Yuanzi found himself overwhelmed by a constant flood of messages and to-dos — until it hit him: AI can handle execution at near-zero cost, but it can't replace the human cost of being present. Attention is the core of human-AI collaboration. He also shared a directly reusable attention-protection playbook: tiered task archiving, distilled personal preference guidelines, and strict daily limits on high-focus hours.

en.title: A DeepSeek Harness plugin just stole the WeChat article formatter's lunch — and it's open source
en.summary: The author has open-sourced a WeChat Official Account drafting workbench built on DeepSeek Harness, pulling scattered AI capabilities into a single unified workspace. It supports targeted section-by-section revisions, AI content QC, custom IP covers, smart image selection and SVG animation generation, and one-stop layout — plus scheduling and data retrospectives, with learnings distilled into reusable Skills. Plugins let you swap skills and visual styles to match your own creative habits. Give it a try!

en.title: Investing and speculating are, at heart, both bets on the people behind them.
en.summary:
Investing and speculation are both, at heart, bets on the people behind the asset. With stocks you study the management team; with coins you read the market maker's intentions.

Facing what would be the largest IPO in human history, @AnthropicAI ($ANT), before deciding how to bet we skip Wall Street's roadshow deck and go straight to CEO Dario Amodei's 2011 Princeton PhD thesis and his Stanford postdoc research files, reverse-engineering this "market maker's" mental model from the ground up.

Many assume Dario comes from a pure computer science background, but his résumé is a hardcore cross-disciplinary history of biophysics plus coding: Princeton biophysics PhD → Stanford School of Medicine proteomics postdoc (wrote 14,000 lines of core code) → early core member at Baidu and Google Brain → VP of Research at OpenAI, where he personally drove…
en.reason: Dario Amodei's 2011 Princeton biophysics PhD thesis and Stanford postdoc archive, where he wrote 14,000 lines of core code, frame a profile tracing his path through Baidu, Google Brain and OpenAI ahead of Anthropic's ($ANT) IPO.

en.title: Take a look at how Anduril, the hottest AI defense tech startup in the US, sees the Jensen Huang incident 👇👇👇 Anduril founder Palmer Luckey says many people are missing the forest for the trees on the Nvidia incident.
en.summary:
Here’s how Anduril, the hottest AI defense-tech startup in the US, views the Jensen Huang incident.

Anduril founder Palmer Luckey says many people are missing the forest for the trees on the Nvidia incident.

He calls it a midwit take and says they have it completely backwards.

Luckey argues that most people don’t understand how selling American GPUs to the Chinese market actually works against the CCP.

LUCKEY: What they don’t understand is that China does not want Nvidia selling GPUs to Chinese companies.

For example, some Chinese companies want to buy Nvidia GPUs. Right now 600,000 H-200 GPUs are sitting in port because China won’t let them...
en.reason: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey calls the Nvidia backlash a "midwit take," arguing that China does not want Nvidia selling GPUs to Chinese firms, with 600,000 H-200 GPUs sitting stacked in port.

sources.summary: 谷歌 Gemini 4 Neon 重磅上线，与氩、碳、氢模型各司其职，定位是 Agent 集群调度中枢，对标 Opus、Sol。它可以调度子代理协同攻坚，独立搭建复杂 3D 场景、前端工程，在多项基准测试中都胜过竞品。开发者们可以上手试试！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Neon（氖，10号元素），百万 token 输入$3、输出$15，比 Carbon 便宜，可在 Google AI Studio 调用。

en.title: Gemini 4 Neon launches: element No. 10, neon
en.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Neon is officially live, with the Argon, Carbon, and Hydrogen models each handling their own role. Positioned as a central orchestrator for Agent swarms, it takes aim at Opus and Sol. It can dispatch sub-agents to work problems in concert, independently build complex 3D scenes and front-end projects, and beats competitors on multiple benchmarks. Developers can give it a try.
en.reason: Google's Gemini 4 Neon, priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, is cheaper than Carbon and positioned as an agent-cluster scheduling hub that coordinates sub-agents on complex 3D scenes and front-end engineering, beating competitors on multiple benchmarks.

en.title: Stanford's Agent engineering course goes open source: learn to build an Agent from scratch
en.summary: Stanford's new course CS329Z focuses on putting AI Agent engineering into practice, building a complete framework around Harness, orchestration frameworks, memory mechanisms, multi-agent systems, evaluation and safety — suited to developers with some background who want a systematic course of study.
en.reason: Stanford's open-sourced CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents, taught by Diyi Yang, Michael Ryan and John Yang from September 23 to December 2, covers RAG, tool calling, two hands-on assignments and a semester project on building and evaluating agents from scratch.
